brief:
Israeli settlers attacked diplomatic vehicles belonging to European missions on Saturday afternoon as they left Taybeh, a Palestinian village east of Ramallah, the Palestine News Network reported. The incident occurred as diplomats were departing the area following what local sources characterized as a visit to the village.

Details of the attack and any injuries or damage to the vehicles were not immediately reported by local sources at the time of the incident.
dek: RAMALLAH, Palestine /PNN / Israeli settlers attacked diplomatic vehicles belonging to European missions on Saturday afternoon as diplomats were leaving the Palestinian village of Taybeh, east of Ramallah, according to local sources.
title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomatic vehicles near Ramallah
